segments.MIC.1.1-1: The LORD gives Micah a message about Samaria and Jerusalem
segments.MIC.1.2-4: The LORD comes down and the mountains melt like wax
segments.MIC.1.5-5: Jacob’s sin is seen in Samaria and Jerusalem
segments.MIC.1.6-7: The LORD will destroy Samaria and its idols
segments.MIC.1.8-10: Micah mourns because Samaria’s wound has reached Judah
segments.MIC.1.11-12: Disaster from the LORD reaches the towns near Jerusalem
segments.MIC.1.13-14: Micah speaks against Lachish and Moresheth-gath
segments.MIC.1.15-16: Micah tells the people of Judah to mourn for exile
segments.MIC.2.3-5: The LORD plans disaster for the proud oppressors
segments.MIC.2.6-8: God accuses his people of acting like enemies
segments.MIC.2.9-11: God accuses oppressors of driving out women and children
segments.MIC.3.1-3: Micah accuses Israel’s leaders of harming the people
segments.MIC.3.4-4: The LORD will not answer the leaders’ cry
segments.MIC.3.5-7: God will bring darkness on prophets who lead people astray
segments.MIC.3.8-8: Micah is filled with power to speak about Israel’s sin
segments.MIC.3.9-11: Leaders, priests and prophets act wrongly for money
segments.MIC.3.12-12: Jerusalem will become a heap of rubble
segments.MIC.4.1-1: In the last days the LORD’s mountain will be highest
segments.MIC.4.2-3: Nations will learn God’s ways and live in peace
segments.MIC.4.4-5: God’s people will live safely and follow the LORD forever
segments.MIC.4.6-8: The LORD will gather the outcast and rule in Zion
segments.MIC.4.9-10: Zion will go to Babylon, and the LORD will rescue her
segments.MIC.4.11-12: Many nations gather against Zion, but God has a plan
segments.MIC.4.13-13: Zion will break many peoples and give wealth to the LORD
segments.MIC.5.1-1: Enemies attack Jerusalem and strike Israel’s judge
segments.MIC.5.2-3: A ruler from long ago will come from small Bethlehem
segments.MIC.5.4-5: The ruler will shepherd Israel and bring peace
segments.MIC.5.6-6: The ruler will deliver Israel from Assyria
segments.MIC.5.7-7: Jacob’s remnant will be like dew from the LORD
segments.MIC.5.8-9: Jacob’s remnant will be like a strong lion
segments.MIC.5.10-11: The LORD will destroy Israel’s horses, chariots and cities
segments.MIC.5.12-15: The LORD will remove sorcery and idols from Israel
segments.MIC.6.1-2: The LORD calls the mountains to hear his case against Israel
segments.MIC.6.3-5: The LORD reminds Israel how he saved the people
segments.MIC.6.6-8: God wants people to act justly, love mercy and walk humbly
segments.MIC.6.9-10: The LORD speaks against dishonest gain in the city
segments.MIC.6.11-12: The LORD condemns false weights, violence and lies
segments.MIC.6.13-15: Because of sin, Israel will not enjoy its harvest
segments.MIC.6.16-16: Israel followed Ahab’s ways, so it will become a ruin
segments.MIC.7.1-2: Micah grieves that no godly person is left
segments.MIC.7.3-4: Leaders are corrupt, and the day of punishment has come
segments.MIC.7.5-6: Micah says people cannot trust even family and friends
segments.MIC.7.7-8: Micah will wait for God, who will be his light
segments.MIC.7.9-9: Israel bears God’s anger until he brings justice
segments.MIC.7.10-10: Israel’s enemy will be shamed and trampled
segments.MIC.7.11-13: Israel’s walls will be rebuilt and people will return
segments.MIC.7.14-15: Micah asks God to shepherd his people and show wonders
segments.MIC.7.16-17: Nations will be ashamed and tremble before the LORD
segments.MIC.7.18-18: Micah praises God for pardoning sin and showing love
segments.MIC.7.19-20: God will forgive Israel’s sins and keep his promises
